faq.title: A few things teams usually ask before getting started.
faq.description: Short answers, clear expectations, and real support behind the platform.

items.question: Do we need technical knowledge to run LumoraEvents?
items.answer: No. LumoraEvents is designed for event teams, with a setup that stays clear and support that stays close when needed.

items.question: How do judges send scores during the competition?
items.answer: Judges score from a clean interface on tablet or phone, so input stays fast and readable under live pressure.

items.question: Can it adapt to our own competition rules?
items.answer: Yes. Scoring logic, judging flow, categories, and timings can be adjusted to fit how your event already works.

items.question: Does it work well on phones and tablets?
items.answer: Yes. The platform is built to work smoothly across modern browsers on mobile, tablet, and desktop.

items.question: Will we have support during the event day?
items.answer: Yes. We stay available before, during, and after the event so operational questions do not turn into stress.

items.question: Can the audience follow the competition live?
items.answer: Yes. Schedules, participants, and results can be shared through a live public experience with clear visibility.

items.question: Do we need to install anything to use it?
items.answer: No installation is required. LumoraEvents runs in the browser, which keeps rollout simple for teams and judges.
